Driving, engaging and confident, starts with energy right away and keeps a steady groove throughout. Minimal sparse dark synth melody so a voiceover stays clear. Instrumental, no vocals. Ends on a clean final bass hit.
b: Aggressive gym phonk beat, 150 BPM. Heavy distorted 808 bass, punchy kick and clap, fast hi-hats, a dark repeating cowbell riff kept low in the mix.
